prompt:
Our AI assistant deployment has a memory database file at memory/index.json that hasn't been touched since early January. We're now on 2025-02-15 and need to do a health audit before our next release.

Please:
1. Update the memory database so that all memory scores reflect how much they've naturally faded since they were last used, as of today (2025-02-15). Any memories with invalid scores should be corrected before the aging is applied.
2. Make sure every memory entry has all the required fields filled in (some may be incomplete).
3. Mark the audit date in the database.
4. Produce a new file called `core-memories.json` containing only the memories that are still important enough to be loaded at the start of every session.

The SKILL.md for the hippocampus memory system documents exactly how aging works and what the importance thresholds are.
